research_question: Can a PCA-warm-started rank-16 FP32 bilinear residual scorer recover MS MARCO Top-10 relevance boundary errors better than FP32 PCA before any quantization is introduced?

data_policy.new_external_test: TBD and SEALED_UNOPENED until the full v2 method and evaluator are frozen
data_policy.source_qrels_disclosure: The legacy 6,980-query MS MARCO qrels container was opened and parsed by the source bundle builder. Only inner-train and inner-validation entries entered bundle labels, loss, selection, or metrics. This is development data, not untouched evidence.

stage_a_fp32_method.query_projection_initialization: alpha times the frozen PCA rank-16 basis
stage_a_fp32_method.score: ann_score + 0.05 * tanh(dot(qWq, residualWd) / 0.05) for frozen ANN positions 1 through 40
stage_a_fp32_method.dynamic_pair_mining: recomputed from current FP32 rankings at the start of every epoch
stage_a_fp32_method.promotion_pairs: correctable relevant candidates currently outside Top-10 versus currently retrieved unjudged-as-negative Top-10 candidates
stage_a_fp32_method.protection_pairs: currently retrieved relevant candidates versus the highest-scoring correctable unjudged-as-negative candidates outside Top-10
stage_a_fp32_method.query_weighting: equal total weight per contributing query within each pair type
stage_a_fp32_method.target_margin: max(0.0001, one times the current local rank-10/rank-11 score gap)

optimization.epoch_selection: highest inner-validation FP32 Recall@10, with epoch 0 PCA warm-start eligible and earliest epoch winning ties

stage_a_stop_rule.success_action: run frozen FP32 seeds 42, 43, and 44 before defining a QAT stage

artifact_policy.complete_run_reuse: only when the full run fingerprint and every output hash match
